pointer.description: Complete trace documentation for SurrealDB authentication fix

criticalPaths.name: SurrealDB Connection
criticalPaths.failurePoint: 401 Unauthorized - Wrong credentials or missing secret

criticalPaths.name: JWT Token Validation
criticalPaths.failurePoint: 401 Invalid token - Inconsistent SECRET_KEY across pods

criticalPaths.name: Schema Initialization
criticalPaths.failurePoint: Tables don't exist or permissions not set

metadata.dataFlow: Login Form → POST /auth/login → Istio Gateway → FastAPI Router → Pydantic Validation → get_surreal_client() → SurrealDB Authentication → User Query → Password Verification (bcrypt) → JWT Generation → Organization Query (N+1) → Response Serialization → localStorage Storage → Dashboard Render → Protected Routes → Activity History
blockers: 401 Unauthorized - SurrealDB credentials missing or incorrect
401 Unauthorized - JWT secret key inconsistency across pods
Schema not initialized - tables missing or permissions not set
N+1 query performance issue in organization fetching
No Redis fallback causing activity timeline failures

performanceBottlenecks.fix: Use IN clause for single query

securityIssues.mitigation: Current: CSP headers. Better: HttpOnly cookies

validationPhases: Phase 1: Infrastructure - Verify secrets and deployments
Phase 2: Database - Test SurrealDB connection and schema
Phase 3: CLI - Run python -m server.cli db validate
Phase 5: Playwright - Automated testing and screenshots
successCriteria: RPC API connects to SurrealDB without 401 errors
CLI validation command passes all checks
Activity history displays data from devbob executions
No 401/500 errors in browser console or RPC API logs
nextSteps: 2. Update Helm values to mount secret correctly
6. Fix N+1 query and Redis fallback
